methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidation fees, which are paid to the Lighter Liquidity Pool (LLP) — i.e. to liquidity providers, not the protocol.

Fees.Transfer Fees: Transfer fees paid by traders on Lighter.
Fees.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: Withdrawal fees paid by traders on Lighter.

Revenue.Transfer Fees: Transfer fees retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Maker and taker fees retained by the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Transfer Fees: Transfer fees retained by the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: Withdrawal fees retained by the protocol.

methodology.Fees: Fees extracted per round: 1% admin fee on all deployed ETH, 1% admin fee on the losers pool, and a 10% vault fee on the losers pool after admin. On rounds where nobody hit the winning block, the entire pot (minus the admin fee) is routed to the Treasury vault. Variable effective rate depending on winner/loser ratio.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees — all fees are paid by players out of their deployed ETH.
methodology.Revenue: All extracted fees: the sum of protocol revenue (admin fees) and holders revenue (vault fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Admin fees (1% of deployed ETH + 1% of losers pool) accruing to the protocol fee wallet.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Vault fee ETH funds automated PEA buybacks — 95% of bought PEA is permanently burned, 5% is distributed to PEA stakers as yield.

Fees.Vault fees: ETH routed to the Treasury vault at settlement (10% of losers pool after admin on normal rounds; the full pot minus admin on no-winner rounds), tracked via VaultReceived events.
Fees.Admin fees: Admin fees (1% of deployed ETH + 1% of losers pool) derived from RoundSettled events, with no-winner rounds recovered from their paired VaultReceived amount.

UserFees.Vault fees: Vault fee portion of the fees paid by players out of their deployed ETH.
UserFees.Admin fees: Admin fee portion of the fees paid by players out of their deployed ETH.

Revenue.Vault fees: Holders revenue portion: vault fee ETH funding PEA buybacks.
Revenue.Admin fees: Protocol revenue portion: admin fees accruing to the protocol fee wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Admin fees: Admin fees accruing to the protocol fee wallet.

HoldersRevenue.Vault Fees to Stakers: 5% of the vault fees are used to buy PEA and distributed to PEA stakers.
HoldersRevenue.Vault Fees to Burn: 95% of the vault fees are used to buy PEA and burned.

methodology.Volume: Total ETH wagered across all lottery rounds, derived from staker rewards (a flat 6% of each round's pot).
methodology.Fees: The 10% rake taken from every round's pot: 6% to veSTEEL stakers, 2% to the keeper, and 2% to the motherlode.
methodology.Revenue: Gross profit: 6% distributed to veSTEEL stakers plus the 2% keeper cut.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 2% keeper self-funding cut retained by the protocol.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veSTEEL stakers (RewardNotified events on VeSteelV2).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 2% of each pot routed to the motherlode, paid back out to winning players.

Fees.Staking Rewards: 6% of each pot distributed to veSTEEL stakers (RewardNotified events).
Fees.Rake to Keeper: 2% of each pot self-funding the keeper.
Fees.Rake to Motherlode: 2% of each pot routed to the motherlode.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: 6% of each pot distributed to veSTEEL stakers.
Revenue.Rake to Keeper: 2% of each pot self-funding the keeper.

ProtocolRevenue.Rake to Keeper: 2% of each pot retained by the protocol for keeper operations.

HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: 6% of each pot distributed to veSTEEL stakers.

SupplySideRevenue.Rake to Motherlode: 2% of each pot routed to the motherlode, paid back out to winning players.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders on swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD; unpriced swaps and bribes are not included.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders plus external bribes paid to voters of the pools. Swap fees count only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD; bribes are valued at the subgraph token price on the bribe day.
methodology.Revenue: Voter and treasury shares of swap fees, allocated when each fee accrues, plus external bribes paid to voters. Swap fees count only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Treasury share of swap fees that accrued while the treasury recipient was not a Ramses holder module (Sarcophagus or Buyback Module), counting only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees allocated to xRAM voters, the treasury share that accrued while it was routed to the Sarcophagus or Buyback Module (Robinhood Chain from 2026-08-16 20:26:47 UTC, Elysium from launch), and external bribes. Swap fees count only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD. This is an allocation at fee accrual, not a measurement of executed buybacks or burials.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees left to liquidity providers after the voter and treasury shares, counting only swaps the Ramses subgraph priced in USD.
methodology.Volume: USD value of swaps in Ramses pools, read from the Ramses subgraph; swaps the subgraph could not price in USD are excluded.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders.
Fees.Bribes: External bribes paid to voters of the pools, valued at the subgraph token price on the bribe day.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders.

Revenue.Swap Fees to holders: Voter share of swap fees, plus the treasury share accrued while routed to the Sarcophagus or Buyback Module.
Revenue.Swap Fees to protocol: Treasury share of swap fees accrued while the recipient was not a Ramses holder module.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees to protocol: Treasury share of swap fees accrued while the recipient was not a Ramses holder module.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees to holders: Voter share of swap fees, plus the treasury share accrued while routed to the Sarcophagus or Buyback Module. In the hour of the Robinhood routing change, the treasury share is split by the time before and after the change.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees to LPs: Swap fees left to liquidity providers after the voter and treasury shares.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap and launch fees retained by the protocol treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Actual swap credits allocated to creators and referrers, including amounts still unclaimed.

Fees.Crypto Swap Fees: Crypto quote-denominated swap fees, including anti-snipe surcharges.

Fees.Stocks Swap Fees: Stocks quote-denominated swap fees, including anti-snipe surcharges.
Fees.Stocks Launch Fees: Stocks token-launch fees from Factory payment events.

Revenue.Crypto Launch Fees To Protocol: Crypto token-launch fees paid to the protocol.
Revenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Protocol: Stocks swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
Revenue.Stocks Launch Fees To Protocol: Stocks token-launch fees paid to the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Protocol: Crypto swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
ProtocolRevenue.Crypto Launch Fees To Protocol: Crypto token-launch fees paid to the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Protocol: Stocks swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
ProtocolRevenue.Stocks Launch Fees To Protocol: Stocks token-launch fees paid to the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Creators: Crypto swap fees credited to token creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Referrers: Crypto swap fees credited to valid referrers.
SupplySideRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Creators: Stocks swap fees credited to token creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Referrers: Stocks swap fees credited to valid referrers.

methodology.Fees: Total fees paid by users on AGNT: (1) the 1.095% Doppler V4 terminal pool fee on tokens launched via the launchpad on Base + Robinhood Chain, derived from the observed on-chain platform fee share (WETH on Base; WETH plus RWA numeraires — tokenized stocks like AAPL that a Robinhood launch pairs against, e.g. $BEER — on Robinhood, priced by DefiLlama; the unpriced launched-token leg is excluded, a conservative lower bound); plus (2) the 0.40% platform fee on in-app swaps (Base), measured as WETH + USDC paid by Relay to AGNT's app-fee recipient wallet; plus (3) fees from PonsV2 launches on Robinhood Chain, read from each token's AgntFeeWedge Split events (native-ETH leg = total user-paid fee); plus (4) native-ETH paid by buyers to mint AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain; plus (5) AGNTS activation fees on Robinhood Chain (ETH fee + $AGNTS cost, from the Activated event); plus (6) AGNTS NFT swap fees on Robinhood Chain (random packs and exact picks; the fee is read from the swap engine at each swap's block).
methodology.Revenue: Fees kept by AGNT: the 32% platform share of launchpad pool fees (WETH released by the Doppler initializers on Base + Robinhood, to 0x5bF5805e…C5f0) plus 100% of the 0.40% swap fee (WETH + USDC paid by Relay on Base to the app-fee recipient wallets — 0x585b6854…0598 pre-repoint and 0x5bF5805e…C5f0 post-repoint) plus AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) protocol cut of PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood (the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split; the remaining 5/7 is forwarded to each token's own engine) plus 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds on Robinhood (a first-party collection, so there is no creator split) plus 100% of AGNTS activation ETH fees and swap fees, and the full $AGNTS activation cost (the treasury share plus the burned share).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue kept by the AGNT treasury: everything in Revenue except the burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of each AGNTS activation's $AGNTS cost that is burned (burnBps, 50% today).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 68% of launchpad pool fees paid to third-party token creators (63%) and the Doppler protocol (~5%), estimated from the observed platform WETH share.

Fees.Launchpad Fees: 1.095% Doppler terminal fee (WETH leg), estimated as platform WETH share / 0.32, on Base + Robinhood Chain.
Fees.Trading Fees: 0.40% swap fee (Base), WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient wallet.
Fees.Pons Launchpad Fees: PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood Chain (native-ETH leg), the `total` of each token's AgntFeeWedge Split event.
Fees.NFT Mint Fees: Native ETH paid by buyers minting AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain, measured as proceeds withdrawn from the mint controller.
Fees.Activation Fees: ETH fee paid to activate an AGNTS NFT (Robinhood), from the Activated event.
Fees.Activation $AGNTS: $AGNTS paid to activate an AGNTS NFT (Robinhood), from the Activated event.
Fees.NFT Swap Fees: ETH fee for AGNTS NFT swaps (random packs and exact picks) on Robinhood, read from the swap engine at each swap's block.

Revenue.Launchpad Fees to Protocol: 32% platform share, WETH released to the fee wallet on Base + Robinhood
Revenue.Trading Fees to Protocol: 100% of the 0.40% swap fee, WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient (Base)
Revenue.Pons Fees to Protocol: AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) cut of PonsV2 launch fees, the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split (Robinhood).
Revenue.NFT Mint Fees to Protocol: 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds (Robinhood) — a first-party collection, so AGNT keeps all of it.
Revenue.Activation Fees to Protocol: 100% of the AGNTS activation ETH fee (Robinhood).
Revenue.Activation $AGNTS to Protocol: The non-burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost, sent to the treasury (Robinhood).
Revenue.Activation $AGNTS Burned: The burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost (Robinhood).

ProtocolRevenue.Launchpad Fees to Protocol: 32% platform share, WETH released to the fee wallet on Base + Robinhood
ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees to Protocol: 100% of the 0.40% swap fee, WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient (Base)
ProtocolRevenue.Pons Fees to Protocol: AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) cut of PonsV2 launch fees, the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split (Robinhood).
ProtocolRevenue.NFT Mint Fees to Protocol: 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds (Robinhood) — a first-party collection, so AGNT keeps all of it.
ProtocolRevenue.Activation Fees to Protocol: 100% of the AGNTS activation ETH fee (Robinhood).
ProtocolRevenue.Activation $AGNTS to Protocol: The non-burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost, sent to the treasury (Robinhood).

HoldersRevenue.Activation $AGNTS Burned: The burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost (Robinhood).

SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Fees to Creators: 63% of launchpad pool fees paid to third-party token creators
SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Fees to Doppler: 5% of launchpad pool fees paid to the Doppler protocol
SupplySideRevenue.Pons Fees to Engine: The ~5/7 (71.43%) of each PonsV2 launch fee forwarded from the AgntFeeWedge to the token's own engine (Robinhood).

methodology.Volume: Total ETH wagered across all bets each round, derived from staker rewards (a flat 8% of wagers).
methodology.Fees: The 10% rake taken from every round's wagers: 8% distributed to veNFT stakers plus 2% routed to the vault.
methodology.Revenue: All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veNFT stakers (RewardDistributed events on CashVoteEscrowStaking).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veNFT stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 2% of wagers routed to the vault pool, which is paid back out to winning players.

Fees.Staking Rewards: 8% of wagers distributed to veNFT stakers (RewardDistributed events).
Fees.Wagers to Jackpot Vault: 2% of wagers routed to the vault pool.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: 8% of wagers distributed to veNFT stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: 8% of wagers distributed to veNFT stakers.

SupplySideRevenue.Wagers to Jackpot Vault: 2% of wagers routed to the vault pool, paid back out to winning players.

methodology.Volume: Everything planted on the grid across both game versions: ETH from the v1 Planted and PlantedMany events, and ETH or AAPL from the v2 Planted events (v2 lets players plant from an AAPL balance).
methodology.Fees: Every plant pays an admin fee at the configured adminFeeBps rate (1% at time of writing) on the AAPL it buys — taken inside the plant on v1, and at the round's seal on v2 (where AAPL-denominated plants pay the same rate on their value and batched plants an extra batchFeeBps, 0 at time of writing). Every revealed round with a winner pays that round's configured rakeBps on the loss pool (the stakes on the 24 plots that did not bloom), split into a fixed 10% to SEED stakers (STAKERS_BPS, a contract constant), the round's configured jackpotBps share to the Golden Apple jackpot, and the remainder to the treasury. Rounds where the blooming plot is empty take no rake — the whole pot rolls into the jackpot.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees — both the admin fee and the rake are paid by players out of what they planted.
methodology.Revenue: Gross profit: the admin fee plus the stakers and treasury cuts of the rake. The jackpot cut is excluded because it is paid back out to players.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The admin fee, withdrawn by the owner via collectAdmin: reconstructed per plant on v1, and on v2 measured as the growth of adminAccrued over the window plus the amounts withdrawn inside it.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value reaching SEED holders: the fixed 10% of each round's rake flushed to SeedStaking as AAPL yield for stakers, plus the treasury remainder that buys SEED back on the DEX and burns it.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The round's configured jackpotBps share of its rake, routed to the Golden Apple jackpot and paid back out to players when it hits.

Fees.Admin Fee: The configured adminFeeBps share of the AAPL bought with every plant: per Planted/PlantedMany event on v1, and per sealed round on v2 (as the growth of adminAccrued plus collectAdmin withdrawals, which also carries the v2 batch fee).
Fees.RAKE: The rake taken on every revealed round with a winner, on both versions.

UserFees.Admin Fee: The configured adminFeeBps share of the AAPL bought with every plant: per Planted/PlantedMany event on v1, and per sealed round on v2 (as the growth of adminAccrued plus collectAdmin withdrawals, which also carries the v2 batch fee).
UserFees.RAKE: The rake taken on every revealed round with a winner, on both versions.

Revenue.Admin Fee: Admin fee on every plant, at the configured adminFeeBps rate.
Revenue.Rake to Stakers: The fixed 10% staker share of each round's rake.
Revenue.Rake to Buyback: The treasury remainder of each round's rake used to buy SEED back on the DEX and burn it.

ProtocolRevenue.Admin Fee: Admin fee on every plant at the configured adminFeeBps rate, withdrawn by the owner via collectAdmin.

HoldersRevenue.Rake to Stakers: The fixed 10% staker share of each round's rake, flushed to SeedStaking as AAPL yield for SEED stakers.
HoldersRevenue.Rake to Buyback: The treasury remainder of each round's rake, spent buying SEED back on the DEX and burning it.

SupplySideRevenue.Rake to Jackpot: The round's configured jackpotBps share of its rake, routed to the Golden Apple jackpot and paid back out to players when it hits.

methodology.Revenue: ETH distributed to LUNA stakers plus the protocol's retained cut.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 1% of each mining round pot and 5% of each Eclipse beacon purchase retained by the protocol.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ETH distributed to LUNA stakers — 8% of each mining round pot and 10% of each beacon purchase.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 2% Motherlode jackpot and 1% Eclipse prize pool funded by each mining round, both paid back out to players.

Fees.Staking Rewards: 8% of each mining round pot and 10% of each Eclipse beacon purchase, distributed to LUNA stakers.
Fees.Protocol Fees: 1% of each mining round pot and 5% of each Eclipse beacon purchase, retained by the protocol.
Fees.Prize Pools: 2% of each mining round pot to the Motherlode jackpot and 1% to the Eclipse prize pool.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: 8% of each mining round pot and 10% of each beacon purchase, distributed to LUNA stakers.
Revenue.Protocol Fees: 1% of each mining round pot and 5% of each beacon purchase, retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: 1% of each mining round pot and 5% of each beacon purchase.

HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: 8% of each mining round pot and 10% of each beacon purchase, distributed to LUNA stakers.

SupplySideRevenue.Prize Pools: The 2% Motherlode jackpot and 1% Eclipse prize pool, paid back out to players.

methodology.Fees: Protocol fee charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps, always collected in ETH or USDG (ProtocolFeeCharged events), converted to USD.
methodology.Revenue: All the fees charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps are retained by the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 100% of the fees charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps are retained by the protocol.

Fees.Protocol Fees: Protocol fee taken by the vault on each shielded withdrawal and swap (ProtocolFeeCharged), in ETH or USDG.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: All the fees charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps are retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: 100% of the fees charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps are retained by the protocol.

methodology.Fees: Accrued 1% SushiSwap V3 trading fees collected in launch token pools plus fixed gas-token fees paid per token launch.
methodology.Revenue: Sushi's share (sushiFeeBps) of accrued V3 trading fees plus fixed launch fees, which belong entirely to Sushi.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Sushi's share (sushiFeeBps) of accrued V3 trading fees plus fixed launch fees, which belong entirely to Sushi.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The remainder of accrued V3 trading fees: paid to the token creator or fee receiver, burned as launch tokens, or spent buying back the launch token, per the launch's fee disposition.

Fees.Trading Fees: Accrued 1% SushiSwap V3 trading fees collected in launch token pools, emitted as quoteCollected and tokenCollected in FeesDistributed.
Fees.Launch Fees: Fixed gas-token fee paid per new token launch; the full amount belongs to Sushi, emitted via LaunchFeesWithdrawn.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Sushi's share of accrued V3 trading fees, emitted as quoteToSushi and tokenToSushi in FeesDistributed.
Revenue.Launch Fees: Fixed launch fee retained by Sushi, emitted via LaunchFeesWithdrawn.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Sushi's share of accrued V3 trading fees, emitted as quoteToSushi and tokenToSushi in FeesDistributed.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees: Fixed launch fee retained by Sushi, emitted via LaunchFeesWithdrawn.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Share of accrued V3 trading fees paid to the token creator (V1) or the launch's fee receiver (V2), emitted in FeesDistributed.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Token Burns: Launch-token fees burned under the V2 burn fee disposition, emitted as launchTokenFeesBurned.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Token Buybacks: Quote fees spent buying back and burning the launch token under the V2 buyback fee disposition, emitted as quoteUsedForBuyback.

methodology.Fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: the transfer tax is paid by token senders.
methodology.Revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury 10% of the Boardwalk share, plus governance epoch budgets that weekly votes direct to the treasury or into permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity (recognized when the epoch executes on Ethereum).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The portion of the governance 90% recognized when each weekly epoch executes on Ethereum with a holder-accruing outcome chosen by sbfBWLK-weighted votes: BWLK buyback-and-burn or distribution to voters.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Tax shares accruing to launch issuers, stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP, referrers and integrators.

Fees.Token Tax: Transfer tax charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens.

UserFees.Token Tax: Transfer tax paid by token senders.

Revenue.Token Tax To Protocol: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps, 30bps when a referrer is set).

ProtocolRevenue.Token Tax To Treasury: 10% of the Boardwalk share, forwarded to the treasury (BoardwalkFeeCollector.GOVERNANCE_BPS).
ProtocolRevenue.Governance Epochs To Treasury: Weekly governance epoch budgets whose winning vote (or forced fallback) sends the WETH to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked BWLK Liquidity: Epoch budgets used to buy BWLK and mint permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity.

HoldersRevenue.BWLK Buyback Burns: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and burned to the dead address.
HoldersRevenue.Voter Distributions: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and streamed to the epoch's voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Creators: Launch issuer's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To LP Stakers: Share streamed to stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP via LPStaking fee epochs (default 15bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Referrers: Referrer's share, carved out of the Boardwalk share on Advanced launches (up to 5bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Integrators: Share split across the five integrator slots (10bps total).

methodology.Volume: Gross WETH deployed across the game grid, including both direct and AutoMiner deployments, taken from the Game's Deployed events.
methodology.Fees: User-paid value from game activity: round admin WETH, WETH vaulted for treasury buybacks (including final-claim settlement rounding dust), ROAR charged for claiming mined rewards early, and AutoMiner execution fees paid to third-party executors.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees. Round fees, treasury-vaulted settlement, and AutoMiner execution fees come from players' WETH, while early-claim fees are deducted from a claimant's ROAR reward.
methodology.Revenue: Fees retained by Roar or accruing to ROAR holders through treasury buybacks and permanent dead-address transfers. AutoMiner execution fees are excluded from revenue because they are paid to third-party executors.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: AutoMiner execution fees paid to third-party executors for submitting users' configured deployments.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Round admin fees allocated to the configured admin recipient, plus any early-claim fees sent to a non-dead-address recipient.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Treasury-vaulted WETH funds ROAR buybacks whose acquired tokens are burned and distributed to stakers. Early-claim ROAR sent to the dead address is also treated as holder revenue through permanent removal from circulation; that transfer does not reduce the token contract's totalSupply.

Volume.Mining Deployments: Gross WETH deployed across all selected grid squares, including deployments submitted through AutoMiner.

Fees.Round Admin Fees: The exact admin WETH retained at settlement: totalSettlementDeployed minus treasurySettlement minus totalSettlementRewards from each RoundSettled event.
Fees.Treasury Vault Fees: The exact WETH received by the Roar treasury in Vaulted events: settlement treasury fees plus final-claim settlement rounding dust. On a no-winner round this includes all deployed WETH after the admin fee.
Fees.Early Claim Fees: ROAR deducted from rewards claimed during a round's configured early-claim fee window, taken directly from RoundClaimed events.
Fees.AutoMiner Execution Fees: WETH execution fees charged from AutoMiner users' funded budgets and paid to third-party executors.

UserFees.Round Admin Fees: Admin WETH paid from players' round deployments.
UserFees.Treasury Vault Fees: Settlement WETH retained from game rounds and sent to the treasury vault.
UserFees.Early Claim Fees: ROAR paid by winners who claim during the early-claim fee window.
UserFees.AutoMiner Execution Fees: WETH paid by AutoMiner users for third-party execution of their configured deployments.

SupplySideRevenue.AutoMiner Execution Fees to Executors: AutoMiner execution fees passed through to the third-party executors that submit configured deployments.

Revenue.Round Admin Fees to Protocol: Round admin WETH allocated to the configured admin recipient.
Revenue.Treasury Vault Fees to Buybacks: Treasury-vaulted WETH reserved for ROAR buybacks, burns, and staking distributions.
Revenue.Early Claim Fees to Dead Address: Early-claim ROAR transferred to the permanent dead address.
Revenue.Early Claim Fees to Protocol: Early-claim ROAR transferred to a configured recipient other than the dead address.

ProtocolRevenue.Round Admin Fees to Protocol: Round admin WETH allocated to the configured admin recipient.
ProtocolRevenue.Early Claim Fees to Protocol: Early-claim ROAR transferred to a configured recipient other than the dead address.

HoldersRevenue.Treasury Vault Fees to ROAR Burn: The 90% burn allocation of treasury-vaulted WETH. Bought ROAR is burned under the deployed treasury's immutable split.
HoldersRevenue.Treasury Vault Fees to ROAR Stakers: The 10% staker allocation of treasury-vaulted WETH. Bought ROAR is distributed to ROAR stakers under the deployed treasury's immutable split.
HoldersRevenue.Early Claim Fees to Dead Address: Early-claim ROAR permanently sent out of circulation to the dead address.

methodology.Fees: Everything users paid the protocol: all native revenue arriving at the chain's fee collector — the PlatformFeeCollector on Robinhood Chain, a bridging collector on each satellite — from the 2% presale service fee, launch tokens' master fee, the bonding pad's 0.5% per-trade skim, the instant-launch fee and the locker's fee-claim cut (FeesReceived logs), PLUS the 10% referrer share carved off the user-attributed streams before they reach the collector (ReferralPaid logs). Satellite revenue is counted on the chain that earned it and excluded from Robinhood when it arrives bridged, so it counts once.
methodology.Revenue: The share of fees the protocol keeps: collector receipts only, so the referrer share is excluded. The protocol retains all of it, with the home-chain split between governance holders and the treasury reported under HoldersRevenue / ProtocolRevenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 10% referrer share, the one part of a fee the protocol does not keep — paid out by the ReferralRegistry to the trader's referrer before the remainder reaches the collector (ReferralPaid logs).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of every home-chain distribution delivered to GovernanceToken holders as native-ETH dividends (FeesDistributed logs; distributions happen only on Robinhood Chain).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The share of every home-chain distribution delivered to the protocol owner (FeesDistributed logs; distributions happen only on Robinhood Chain).

Fees.Platform Fees: Revenue received by the chain's fee collector (PlatformFeeCollector on Robinhood Chain; a bridging collector on each satellite) from every protocol stream: the 2% presale service fee, launch tokens' master fee, the bonding pad's 0.5% per-trade skim, the instant-launch fee, and the locker's fee-claim cut. From FeesReceived logs. Bridge re-deliveries are excluded on Robinhood so satellite revenue counts once, at origin.
Fees.Fees Paid Out To Referrers: The 10% referrer share carved off the user-attributed streams (pad trade skim, presale service fee, instant-launch fee) by the ReferralRegistry before the remainder reaches the collector — paid by the user, kept by the referrer, so it counts as fees but not as protocol revenue (ReferralPaid logs).

Revenue.Platform Fees Retained By The Protocol: Every fee that reaches the collector is retained by the protocol and later split between governance holders and the treasury on the home chain — see HoldersRevenue / ProtocolRevenue for the split.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees Paid Out To Referrers: The referrer's 10% cut, paid out before the remainder reaches the collector (ReferralPaid logs).

HoldersRevenue.Fees To Governance Holders: The share of every distribution paid to GovernanceToken holders as native-ETH dividends (holdersAmount of FeesDistributed).

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Treasury: The share of every distribution paid to the protocol owner (ownerAmount of FeesDistributed).

methodology.Volume: Gross ETH paid by purchasers for acquisitions (rips), excluding refunded, expired, or slippage-cancelled requests.
methodology.Fees: Acquisition fees paid by basket purchasers (net of the slice credited back to them as RIP buying power), settlement fees and retained backing taken from listings, plus the 1% hook fee on every ETH/RIP swap.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's cut of acquisition and settlement fees, retained settlement penalties, and hook swap fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue paid to the protocol treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Protocol fees diverted to RIP buybacks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of acquisition fees distributed to basket depositors (equal split across active listings plus the top-listing pot), plus retained settlement backing when it is configured to go to depositors instead of the protocol.

Fees.Acquisition Fees: ETH paid by purchasers to acquire a random basket from the pool, net of the slice credited back to the purchaser as RIP buying power.
Fees.Settlement Fees: Fee on the listing backing, charged when a settlement returns the backing to the depositor (purchaser keeps or relists the basket).
Fees.Retained Settlement Penalties: The share of the listing backing retained when a purchaser takes the discounted settlement instead of the basket.
Fees.Swap Fees: 1% hook fee on every ETH/RIP swap: taken in ETH on sells, and in RIP on buys, which the hook converts to ETH in the same transaction (valued at the swap's pool price).

Revenue.Settlement Fees: Settlement fees accrue entirely to the protocol.
Revenue.Retained Settlement Penalties: Retained settlement backing kept by the protocol.
Revenue.Swap Fees: Hook swap fees accrue entirely to the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Acquisition Fees: Protocol cut of acquisition fees paid to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Settlement Fees: Settlement fees paid to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Retained Settlement Penalties: Retained settlement penalties paid to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees: Hook swap fees paid to the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.RIP Buyback: Protocol fees diverted to RIP buybacks.

SupplySideRevenue.Acquisition Fees: Share of acquisition fees distributed to basket depositors, split equally across active listings.
SupplySideRevenue.Top Listing Reward: Share of acquisition fees accruing to the depositor of the top-backed listing.
SupplySideRevenue.Retained Settlement Penalties: Retained settlement penalties redistributed among active depositors when not routed to the protocol.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by users
methodology.Fees: Total swap fees paid by traders on Orvex v2 Solidly pools (0.18% volatile / 0.04% stable) and Orvex v4 concentrated liquidity pools.
methodology.Revenue: All swap fees are revenue - the LP portion is routed to veORVX voters via the gauge system, and any protocol-fee portion goes to the Orvex treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Portion of swap fees taken as the on-chain protocolFee on v4 pools (0 by default). v2 takes no protocol fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Portion of swap fees distributed to veORVX voters through the gauge/FeeDistributor flow (v2: 100% of fees; v4: fee minus protocolFee).

Revenue.Swap Fees To veORVX Holders: Swap fees distributed to veORVX voters via gauges.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Swap fees taken by the protocol (v4 on-chain protocolFee).

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Swap fees taken by the protocol (v4 on-chain protocolFee).

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To veORVX Holders: Swap fees distributed to veORVX voters via gauges.

methodology.Fees: The 0.25% fee charged on every trade, taken in whichever token the trader pays with. pools.trade charges nothing to launch a token and takes no cut of the raise. Traders also pay Uniswap's own 0.04% protocol fee on pools where it is switched on; that is Uniswap's charge, not pools.trade's, and is left out here.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The whole 0.25% trading fee: the creator's share plus the part that is compounded back into the locked liquidity.
methodology.Revenue: Zero. pools.trade keeps none of the trading fee — it all goes to the token's creator and back into the pool's own permanently locked liquidity.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Zero. pools.trade has no treasury cut, no launch fee and no graduation fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Zero. There is no pools.trade token.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: 0.25% of every trade, read per trade from the swap's own fee rate with Uniswap's separate 0.04% protocol fee removed.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees Compounded Into Locked Liquidity: Everything else, added straight back into the pool's permanently locked position instead of being paid out to anyone.

methodology.Volume: Quote-currency volume reconstructed from each hook's FeeAccrued amount and the pool's on-chain feeRate (fee × 1,000,000 ÷ feeRate). Native ETH and USDG pools are priced by DefiLlama from the quote asset.
methodology.Fees: Total launch-tax fees emitted by LetsCash hooks through FeeAccrued events. The launch configuration's fee rate is already reflected in the emitted amount.
methodology.Revenue: The platform share of launch-tax fees, plus the creator share for self-burn pools because that share buys and burns the launched token.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 75% of the platform share, with the other 25% used for the CASHCAT buyback-and-burn lane.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 25% of the platform share used to buy and burn CASHCAT, plus 100% of the creator share for self-burn pools.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator share of launch-tax fees for standard pools; self-burn pools have no creator payout.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Total fee amount emitted by the LetsCash hook for each pool trade.

Revenue.Platform Fees: The fee amount retained by LetsCash after the creator share defined in the pool's launch configuration.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: The creator share of self-burn pools, used to buy and burn the launched token.

ProtocolRevenue.Platform Fees: 75% of the platform share retained for treasury and operations; 25% funds CASHCAT buyback-and-burn.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of the platform share buys and burns CASHCAT; self-burn creator shares buy and burn the launched token.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: The creator share defined in the pool's launch configuration.

methodology.UserFees: All swap fees paid by traders.
methodology.Fees: All swap fees paid by traders, using each pool's Algebra dynamic fee as it stood at the block of each swap.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees routed out of the pool to the fee vault, taken from each pool's on-chain community fee. This is the veLUTE voters' share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Vault-routed swap fees, forwarded through the pool gauge to veLUTE voters. The fee vault sends its entire take to the gauge, so this equals Revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers. LPs do not earn fees while a pool routes its full community fee onward; instead they are compensated with LUTE emissions. Currently zero, since every pool routes 100%.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across Alandale concentrated-liquidity pools, counted once per swap.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees collected from all pools.

Revenue.Swap Fees to veLUTE lockers: Portion of swap fees going to the veLUTE lockers.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees to veLUTE lockers: Portion of swap fees going to the veLUTE lockers.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Portion of swap fees kept by liquidity providers.

methodology.Fees: Original INDEX and earn-a-stock taxes settled into stock distributions, plus gross creator-coin taxes harvested by Index Treasuries (Harvested.netCredit plus Harvested.protocolFee).
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: both generations originate from taxes paid by protocol users.
methodology.Revenue: Original INDEX and earn-a-stock distributions settled for $INDEX holders, plus the Index Treasury protocol fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocolFee portion of each harvest, allocated to The Index protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The toCreator portion of each harvest, claimable by the launched coin's creator, plus finalized Index Treasury paidSum stock paid to launched-coin holders; skipped and unpaid leaves are excluded.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Original INDEX Distributed stock pots and earn-a-stock Cranked deliveries to $INDEX holders.

Fees.Original INDEX Swap Taxes: Original INDEX 3% swap tax, measured after conversion into stock.
Fees.Earn-A-Stock Launch Fees: Earn-a-stock launch fees, measured after conversion into stock.
Fees.Creator Coin Taxes: Gross creator-coin taxes harvested by Index Treasuries.

UserFees.Original INDEX Swap Taxes: Original INDEX swap taxes paid by traders.
UserFees.Earn-A-Stock Launch Fees: Earn-a-stock launch fees paid by traders.

Revenue.Original INDEX Stock Distributions: Original INDEX stock pot settled for token holders.
Revenue.Earn-A-Stock Launch Distributions: Earn-a-stock launch rewards settled for token holders.
Revenue.Creator Coin Taxes To Protocol: Protocol fee retained by The Index.

ProtocolRevenue.Creator Coin Taxes To Protocol: The protocolFee portion of each harvest, allocated to The Index protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Coin Taxes To Coin Creators: The toCreator portion of each harvest, claimable by the launched coin's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Index Treasury Stock Distributions: RoundFinalized.paidSum stock paid to launched-coin holders; skipped and unpaid leaves are excluded.

HoldersRevenue.Original INDEX Stock Distributions: Stock pots settled by all four historical $INDEX distributors.
HoldersRevenue.Earn-A-Stock Launch Distributions: Stock delivered by both historical earn-a-stock reward vaults.

methodology.Fees: The arbitrage profit the hook realises and distributes, summed from the ProfitCurrencyDistribute event the first hook emits on every distribution; for the v2 hook (since 4 October 2026), every leg its executor pays — the swapper's cashback and the LPs' share it declares in ProfitCurrencyDistribute, plus the ProtocolRevenue, ReferralRewarded and PartnerRevenue it pays on top, including on the DELTA integration that shares the executor; plus the profit the HOOKR integration reports in its own ArbitrageProfitSplit and ProfitRecaptured events. The hook closes the price gap a swap opens between connected pools within the same transaction, so this is value recaptured from MEV rather than a fee charged to anyone.
methodology.Revenue: The share of that profit retained by the protocol treasury: the executor's ProtocolRevenue event (90% on WTH's own pools, 40% on pools that integrate WTH, since 2 September 2026; on the v2 hook's distributions and on the DELTA integration's, paid on top of the declared amounts) plus any profit donated into WTH's own pools, which was the treasury's income before that event existed. On an arbitrage run by the HOOKR integration it is the wthProtocolAmount leg of the ArbitrageProfitSplit event, and on a recapture the treasuryAmount of the ProfitRecaptured event.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue — nothing is distributed to token holders on chain.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Everything not retained: the cashback paid to the trader whose swap created the opportunity, the profit donated to the liquidity providers of integrating pools, any referral share paid to an integrating partner, an integrating partner's cut (PartnerRevenue — DELTA's, on arbitrage started in its pools), and, on an arbitrage run by the HOOKR integration, the whole of the profit the protocol did not keep — the partner pays the trader, the trigger pool and its own treasury out of it; on a recapture, the hookAmount the event assigns to the pool's hook.
methodology.UserFees: Zero. Users are not charged by the hook; a swapper receives cashback rather than paying anything.

Fees.MEV Rewards: Arbitrage profit captured by the hook when a swap moves one pool away from a connected pool, closed out in the same transaction — on the v2 hook, every leg its executor pays — together with the profit an integrating partner's own arbitrage reports in its ArbitrageProfitSplit or ProfitRecaptured event.

Revenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: Retained by the protocol treasury: the executor's ProtocolRevenue event, the wthProtocolAmount leg of an ArbitrageProfitSplit, the treasuryAmount of a ProfitRecaptured, plus profit donated into WTH's own pools.

ProtocolRevenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: Retained by the protocol treasury: the executor's ProtocolRevenue event, the wthProtocolAmount leg of an ArbitrageProfitSplit, the treasuryAmount of a ProfitRecaptured, plus profit donated into WTH's own pools.

SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards To Traders: Cashback paid to the trader whose swap created the arbitrage opportunity.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards To LPs: Donated to the liquidity providers of the integrating pool the profit was taken from.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards To Referrers: Referral share paid to the referrer configured for the pool, where one is.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards To Partners: Profit handed to an integrating partner: on an arbitrage it ran itself, the whole of what the protocol did not keep (the partner pays the trader's cashback, the trigger pool's liquidity providers and its own treasury out of it); on a recapture, the hookAmount the event assigns to the pool's hook; and the PartnerRevenue a v2 executor pays a partner whose pool started the arbitrage (DELTA).

methodology.Fees: USDG charged to renters when a GPU lease is finalised onchain. Deposits are taken up front but only the time actually consumed is charged; the unused remainder is refunded in the same transaction and is not counted.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of each finalised lease, currently 10% of the amount charged.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as revenue (10% of GPU lease amount). The protocol's share accrues to the Prism treasury and none of it is distributed to token holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The remainder of each finalised lease, paid to the operator whose GPU served it.

Fees.GPU Lease Rent: USDG charged for GPU time actually consumed when a lease is finalised. Unused deposit is refunded in the same transaction and is not counted.

Revenue.GPU Lease Rent To Protocol: Protocol share of each finalised GPU lease, currently 10% of the amount charged.

ProtocolRevenue.GPU Lease Rent To Protocol: Protocol share of each finalised GPU lease, currently 10% of the amount charged, accruing to the Prism treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.GPU Lease Rent To Providers: Remainder of each finalised GPU lease, paid to the operator whose GPU served it.

methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees. Both fees are deducted independently from matched taker output.
methodology.Fees: All taker fees transferred by the router: the governance-configured protocol fee plus call-scoped integrator fees charged by the official interface.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees sent to the STATE vault, or to the 2DEEP governor from 2026-09-22, plus official-interface integrator fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol fees held by the 2DEEP governor from 2026-09-22, plus integrator fees sent to the official Deepstate interface recipients.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Protocol fees sent to the STATE vault for pro-rata redemption by STATE holders, until governance moved the protocol fee to the 2DEEP governor on 2026-09-22.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Zero. Resting-order makers receive execution proceeds and token incentives, not taker fees.
methodology.Volume: USDG notional matched across every registered Deepstate pool. Direct fills, batched matches, subtree matches, third-party fills, and every routed leg touching a pool are included from router events.

Fees.Protocol fees: Governance-configured taker fee transferred by the router to the STATE vault, or to the 2DEEP governor from 2026-09-22.
Fees.Interface fees: Call-scoped integrator fee charged by the official Deepstate interface.

UserFees.Protocol fees: Governance-configured taker fee deducted from matched taker output.
UserFees.Interface fees: Official-interface integrator fee deducted independently from matched taker output.

Revenue.Fees to STATE vault: Protocol fees sent to the STATE vault.
Revenue.Fees to 2DEEP governor: Protocol fees sent to the 2DEEP governor from 2026-09-22.
Revenue.Official interface fees: Integrator fees sent to the official Deepstate interface recipients.

HoldersRevenue.Fees to STATE vault: Protocol fees sent to the STATE vault for pro-rata redemption by STATE holders.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees to 2DEEP governor: Protocol fees held by the 2DEEP governor, spent only through governance proposals.
ProtocolRevenue.Official interface fees: Integrator fees sent to the official Deepstate interface recipients.

methodology.Volume: Gross ETH paid by purchasers for settled Pack draws (expected value plus the protocol surcharge), excluding refunded and expired requests and the third-party randomness fee.
methodology.Fees: The protocol surcharge over fair value on settled Pack draws, net of purchaser $FWS-allowance rebates, plus redemption-fee skims on won stock lots and zap entry/exit fees.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol cut of pack fees, redemption-fee skims and zap fees, all accruing to the treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue: the treasury's cut of pack fees, redemption skims and zap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: $FWS buybacks funded from the protocol's buyback share and from liquidated redemption skims (burned or redistributed).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Depositors' net take from pack sales (their pro-rata share of the gross price minus the fair value of the lots forfeited), plus the Corner Office pot paid to the top-backed lot's depositor.

Fees.Pack Fees: The 10% protocol surcharge over the quoted expected value on settled Pack draws, net of the surcharge slice rebated to purchasers as $FWS allowances.
Fees.Redemption Fees: Stock tokens skimmed (redeemFeeBps, 5% at launch, snapshotted per Pack) when a winner claims, relists or swaps out a won lot.
Fees.Zap Fees: 1% zap fee on ETH entering via zap-in plus 1% swap fee on stock exits to ETH.

Revenue.Pack Fees: Protocol cut (1%) of pack fees, sent to the treasury.
Revenue.Redemption Fees: Redemption skims accrue to the protocol and are later liquidated into $FWS buy-and-burns.
Revenue.Zap Fees: Zap and swap fees accrue to the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Pack Fees: Depositors' net take: the pro-rata pack-price distribution across active Lots minus the fair value of the drawn lots forfeited. Can be negative in idle periods when the full surcharge is rebated to the purchaser.
SupplySideRevenue.Corner Office Pot: 2.5% of each pack fee accruing to the depositor of the top-backed lot (the Corner Office).

HoldersRevenue.Token Buybacks: $FWS buybacks: the scheduled buyback (40/40/20 split across depositors, purchasers and burn) plus buy-and-burns funded by liquidated redemption skims.

methodology.Volume: USD notional of spot swaps executed through lockin whose transaction lockin verified on-chain.
methodology.Fees: Platform fee on every swap: 1% standard, 0.9% for verified traders, 0.1% on TopBlast v2 / Groypad coins on TON.
methodology.UserFees: Users pay the platform fee on each swap, on top of underlying DEX/router fees.
methodology.Revenue: Platform fees minus referral and copy-trade shares paid out of them.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Platform fees minus referral and copy-trade shares, kept in lockin's fee wallets.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Referral and copy-trade shares paid to inviters and copied traders out of the platform fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No fees are distributed to token holders.

Fees.Trading Fees: Platform fee (1% / 0.9% / 0.1% tiers) charged on spot swaps routed through lockin.

UserFees.Trading Fees: Platform fee paid by users on each swap.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Platform fees kept by lockin after referral and copy-trade shares.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Platform fees kept by lockin after referral and copy-trade shares.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral Payouts: Referral and copy-trade shares paid out of the platform fee.

methodology.Fees: Gross 1% Uniswap V3 trading fees on every token launched through token.select, plus a flat ETH deployment fee per launch and a migration fee charged when a launch graduates to a live pool.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of token/WETH pool trading fees (serviceChargeRate on each token, currently 20%), the whole of every token/$SELECT pool fee harvest, which the factory transfers in full to the treasury, plus all deployment and migration fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of token/WETH pool trading fees, the whole of every token/$SELECT pool fee harvest, plus all deployment and migration fees. token.select has no token buyback.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Token/WETH pool trading fees paid out to the token's creator, its referrer where one is attached, and the contributors who funded the launch. Token/$SELECT pool fees are excluded: they accrue entirely to the treasury.

Fees.Trading Fees: Gross 1% trading fees on the token/WETH pool every launch creates.
Fees.Token/$SELECT Pool Trading Fees: 1% trading fees harvested from the token/$SELECT pool every launch creates.
Fees.Token Deployment Fees: Flat ETH fee charged when a token is deployed.
Fees.Migration Fees: Fixed ETH fee plus a percentage of contributed ETH, charged on graduation.

Revenue.Trading Fees to Protocol: Platform share of token/WETH pool trading fees, read per token from serviceChargeRate.
Revenue.Token/$SELECT Pool Trading Fees: Token/$SELECT pool fees in full — collectSelectPoolFees transfers both amounts to the treasury, with no creator, referrer or contributor split.
Revenue.Token Deployment Fees: Flat ETH fee charged when a token is deployed.
Revenue.Migration Fees: Fixed ETH fee plus a percentage of contributed ETH, charged on graduation.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees to Contributors and Creator: Token/WETH pool trading fees routed to creators, referrers and launch contributors.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders at the dynamic fee carried in each Swap event.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders at the dynamic fee carried in each Swap event, plus any fee FablesBribes takes from bribes (0% so far).
methodology.Revenue: From the ve(3,3) launch on 2026-10-20: swap fees earned by liquidity staked in gauges (booked as they accrue) and the 10% claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity (booked when the ledger skims it), paid to veFABLES voters or to the treasury. Not broken out before the launch (reported as 0), when the claim fee went to the treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: From 2026-10-20: the claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity in pools without a gauge or without votes, and on hooks whose claim-fee recipient is a treasury Safe, plus the fees of emergency-killed gauges and any bribe fee. Vote-churn penalties are not included.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: From 2026-10-20: swap fees earned by liquidity staked in a gauge that has votes and the claim fee taken from unstaked liquidity in those pools, paid to the pool's veFABLES voters, plus bribes from other parties forwarded to those voters (bribes paid by the Fables team excluded).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers: from 2026-10-20, unstaked ledger LPs after the claim fee, LPs holding plain Uniswap v4 positions in Fables pools, and stakers refunded when their gauge has no votes; before it, every swap fee.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across every Fables pool, enumerated from the on-chain FablesPoolRegistry and read from the Uniswap v4 PoolManager Swap logs, counted on the native or core-asset leg.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Dynamic swap fees paid by traders, taken from each Uniswap v4 Swap event.
Fees.Bribe Fees: The cut FablesBribes takes from bribes when they are forwarded to voters (0% so far).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Dynamic swap fees paid by traders, taken from each Uniswap v4 Swap event.

Revenue.Staked LP Fees To Voters: Swap fees earned by ledger shares staked in a gauge that has votes, booked as they accrue and paid to that gauge's veFABLES voters.
Revenue.Claim Fees To Voters: The claim fee (10%) taken from unstaked ledger liquidity in pools whose gauge has votes, forwarded to the epoch distributor for the voters.
Revenue.Claim Fees To Treasury: The claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity paid to the treasury: pools without a gauge or without votes, and hooks whose claim-fee recipient is a treasury Safe.
Revenue.Killed Gauge Fees To Treasury: Fees of liquidity staked in an emergency-killed gauge, and its claim fee, paid to the treasury for that epoch.
Revenue.Bribe Fees To Treasury: The protocol cut taken from bribes when they are forwarded to voters (0% so far).

HoldersRevenue.Staked LP Fees To Voters: Swap fees earned by ledger shares staked in a gauge that has votes, booked as they accrue and paid to that gauge's veFABLES voters.
HoldersRevenue.Claim Fees To Voters: The claim fee (10%) taken from unstaked ledger liquidity in pools whose gauge has votes, forwarded to the epoch distributor for the voters.
HoldersRevenue.Bribes To Voters: Bribes other parties post on FablesBribes for a pool's veFABLES voters, counted when forwarded to the voters' distributor, net of any bribe fee. Bribes paid from Fables team Safes are excluded.

ProtocolRevenue.Claim Fees To Treasury: The claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity paid to the treasury: pools without a gauge or without votes, and hooks whose claim-fee recipient is a treasury Safe.
ProtocolRevenue.Killed Gauge Fees To Treasury: Fees of liquidity staked in an emergency-killed gauge, and its claim fee, paid to the treasury for that epoch.
ProtocolRevenue.Bribe Fees To Treasury: The protocol cut taken from bribes when they are forwarded to voters (0% so far).

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers: unstaked ledger LPs after the claim fee, plain Uniswap v4 positions in Fables pools, and staked LPs refunded when their gauge has no votes (before 2026-10-20, every swap fee).

methodology.Volume: The ETH leg of every buy and sell routed through the Robin Labs swap desk.
methodology.Fees: Per-coin trading fees of 1%-4% per side, chosen by each creator at launch and immutable afterwards, the 0.25% trader/holder reward leg when a RewardVault is wired, and the fixed rewards paid out when a coin graduates. The share of each fee used to buy back and burn the launched coin is netted out rather than counted.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of trading fees, including the portion deferred until a coin graduates and the 25% treasury cut of above-default fee tiers, plus the protocol's graduation reward.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All protocol revenue is retained by the treasury. The live deployment has no on-chain path routing any of it to token holders, so none is booked as holders revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's share of trading fees and their graduation reward, the share minted into that coin's permanent buy wall, and the 0.25% reward leg paid out to traders and coin holders.

Volume.Trading Volume: ETH in on buys and ETH out on sells, routed through the swap desk.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The full per-side trading fee paid by the trader.

methodology.Revenue: The 30 bps protocol fee routed to FeeRouter, plus the share spent buying back and burning HKRS, the protocol's own token.

Buybacks on third-party launches are excluded and counted as supply side, since they accrue to those tokens' holders. Discretionary buybacks are funded from fees already counted as protocol revenue, so this figure overlaps ProtocolRevenue rather than adding to Revenue.

Fees.LP Fees: The pool's own Uniswap v4 LP fee on hookless launch styles, collected through LiquidityCustody (FeesCollected plus the matching ProtocolFeePaid).

methodology.Fees: Everything users pay the protocol: the price of every cat minted, the trading fee the hook takes on the $HASH pool, and the secondary-market royalty the collection routes to the hook. The mint price is derived per cat from the contract's own curve - the number of cats created so far times PRICE_STEP - rather than read from a transaction value, so a mint sent with excess ether cannot inflate it.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees. Every one of the three flows is paid by a user: the miner pays the entry price, the trader pays the swap fee, and the secondary-market buyer pays the royalty.
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus the rent paid out to living cats.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Rent paid to the cats already alive. Every mint splits its price between the cats that came before it and the hook; cat holders are suppliers whose asset earns, not holders of a governance token, so their cut is a cost of revenue. Measured as the mint price minus the hook's cut, which is exact and needs no reconstruction from the rent accumulator. The hook's cut is what it was owed in the window rather than what it was sent: a transfer that fails its gas stipend is held in the collection's hookDue and forwarded later, so the change in that balance is added back.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of revenue that joins the hook's buyback queue and is spent buying $HASH back on the pool and burning it. Measured at the fee source - the moment the hook receives and splits the money - rather than when a buyback executes, since the queue is drained gradually under a per-block cap.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The developer's share of revenue, at the hook's devBps rate, read from the chain rather than hardcoded.

methodology.Fees: What users pay to cross the bridge. The asset's controller on Arc charges the same rate in both directions - on the way in it mints the fee to the protocol and the rest to the user, on the way out it burns the gross and re-mints the fee - and an optional fast-lane router charges its own cut on top for skipping the queue, on the origin chain when depositing and on Arc when redeeming. Anything charged on Arc is taken in the claim token (bCRCL, bGLD, bUSDT, bBTCB), which is a 1:1 claim on the asset held in custody and is therefore valued as that origin asset; a fast-lane deposit is charged on the origin chain instead, before the asset becomes a claim, so it is taken in the origin token directly. Either way the fee is denominated in the same four origin assets.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, taken from each Swap event's swapFeeAmount. The Vault charges the fee on the input token; it is booked on the same leg as the volume. When that leg is the output token (a non-core token sold for a core asset), the fee is converted at the trade's own rate, amountOut * swapFeeAmount / amountIn - no external price is used. The amount is exact; only its denomination changes. Because amountIn includes the fee itself and the trade's average rate is slightly worse than the pool's marginal rate, the converted fee reads low by about the pool's fee rate plus the trade's own price impact - a share of the fee, never of volume, and always in the under-counting direction.

methodology.Fees: Everything users pay through Packed: the flat 0.0004 ETH launch fee, the 1% fee on every trade on a Packed bonding curve (Robinhood Chain), the 1% LP fee of every Packed coin's Uniswap v4 pool (after graduation on Robinhood Chain, from launch on Ethereum), the creator tax a coin's creator sets at launch (0-5%, on curve trades and pool swaps), the anti-snipe charges of a coin's first seconds or first block, and the bids paid for seats in packs launched from deposits on Ethereum. methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's 75% of the 1% curve and pool fees, the whole creator tax and anti-snipe charges, and the launcher's half of seat bids. For a reward coin the creator's share goes to the coin's holders instead.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ETH Packed spends buying back $PACKD, its own token, on the open market on Robinhood Chain; the coins bought are burned. Only the fee wallet's buys are counted: they are paid out of Packed's revenue above and moved out of ProtocolRevenue.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Keyholders: 50% of room-token swap fees, claimable by the room's keyholders.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Mosh's share of the creator fees (creatorFeeShareBps, 20% at launch), the raise fee (raiseFeeBps, 5% of the filled raise), and, where the Mosh treasury holds a bundle's fee claims itself, its pro-rata part of the backers' share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The bundle backers' share of the creator fees (80% at launch), including any team share a bundle's creator set out of it, less the part the Mosh treasury holds as a backer.

Fees.Pons creator fees routed to bundles: The creator share of Pons trading fees on a bundle's token, received by its swarm contract (FeesSynced.received).
Fees.Bundle raise fees: The one-time fee on a bundle's filled raise (5%), paid to the Mosh treasury in the launch transaction. The part of a raise the treasury funded itself is excluded, since that fee is the treasury paying itself.

Revenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury: Mosh's share of the creator fees, paid to its treasury at each sync (FeesSynced.toTreasury).
Revenue.Bundle raise fees: The raise fee, all of it Mosh's.
Revenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury as a bundl: The part of the backers' share credited to the Mosh treasury's own fee claims, in proportion to its claim over all claims at each sync ($BUN: all of it).

ProtocolRevenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury: Mosh's share of the creator fees, paid to its treasury at each sync (FeesSynced.toTreasury).
ProtocolRevenue.Bundle raise fees: The raise fee, all of it Mosh's.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury as a bundl: The part of the backers' share credited to the Mosh treasury's own fee claims, in proportion to its claim over all claims at each sync ($BUN: all of it).

SupplySideRevenue.Creator fees to bundle backers: The backers' share of the creator fees, credited to their claims at each sync (FeesSynced.toContributors), less the treasury's part as a backer.

methodology.Fees: QUOTUM trading tax collected by TaxSink, measured in NVDA when claimed, excluding Pons platform fees and direct funding transfers.
methodology.Revenue: Claimed QUOTUM trading tax less the NVDA forwarded to pay inference providers; NVDA forwarded to fund the protocol's own trading agent stays in revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The fixed 40% share of claimed QUOTUM trading tax transferred to the protocol recipient in NVDA.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Successful buyback NVDA is booked only in hours with burns, capped at positive revenue from UTC midnight through that hour, after subtracting earlier holders bookings that day. No holders revenue is booked when that budget is zero or negative. Excess reserve-funded spending, failed purchases and direct token burns are excluded.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: NVDA forwarded from TaxSink to pay inference providers, excluding the portion the team reports moving on to fund the protocol's trading agent.

Fees.QUOTUM Trading Tax: Gross NVDA collected in TaxSink claims before the fixed 40% protocol share is transferred.

Revenue.QUOTUM Trading Tax: Gross claimed NVDA trading tax less NVDA forwarded to pay inference providers.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Tax To Protocol: The fixed 40% share of claimed trading tax transferred to the protocol recipient.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Successful QUOTUM buyback spend in each burn hour, limited to revenue from UTC midnight through that hour, less holders revenue already booked that day. Reserve-funded excess is excluded.

SupplySideRevenue.Inference Provider Payments: NVDA forwarded to pay for inference, net of the trading-agent funding in the team's published per-session records; a forward counts in full until its record is published.

methodology.Fees: The protocol's fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell (20% at launch). v1 vault (NVDA Printer): fixed at the sale and recognized one hour later when the Safe can no longer void the sale; a voided sale charges no fee; a call sold outside the desk (not possible with the current operator) counts the fee the operator reports at settlement. v2 and v2.1 funds (Robinhood Chain and BNB Chain): the premium stays escrowed in the fund until the epoch settles, so the fee is counted at settlement, as the fund reports it (EpochSettled.fee); voided positions and unpriced settlements charge none. The premium itself is not counted as fees: it is the buyer's payment for the option, which depositors carry against the risk of the option settling in the money (see the options adapter's premium volume).
methodology.Revenue: All of the fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of the fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.

Fees.Desk fee on option premiums: v1: desk fee fixed at each sale (QuotedLocked.fee), zero if the sale was voided (QuotedVoided); for a call sold outside the desk, the fee recorded at settlement (getEpoch.feePaid). v2 / v2.1: the fee each fund books when an epoch settles (EpochSettled.fee), in USDG on Robinhood Chain and USDT on BNB Chain.

Revenue.Desk fee on option premiums: The same fee, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Desk fee on option premiums: The same fee, credited to the HedgeHood treasury Safe.

methodology.Revenue: What Credence keeps: 20% of each token vault's creator fees, which buys back and burns $PFWA, the protocol's cut of creator vault fees, and launch fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue sent to the Credence Safe: the protocol's cut of creator vault fees and the launch fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The 20% of each token vault's creator fees that is spent buying $PFWA sent to the dead address, counted when the fees are collected.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 80% of each token vault's creator fees, bridged to Polygon to fund the token's Polymarket bet (whose winnings buy back and burn the token), and the creator vault fees held for the X account they belong to.

Fees.Creator Trading Fees: Pons creator trading fees collected by a Credence token's vault (v2 vaults when collected, v1 vaults when harvested), in WETH.
Fees.Creator Vault Fees: Pons creator trading fees paid into a CreatorFeeVault for the X account a token was launched for, in the token's pair asset.
Fees.Launch Fees: The Credence fee each launch pays on top of Pons' own launch fee.

UserFees.Creator Trading Fees: Creator trading fees paid by traders of Credence tokens on Pons.
UserFees.Creator Vault Fees: Creator trading fees paid by traders of creator-vault tokens on Pons.
UserFees.Launch Fees: The Credence fee paid by the token's creator at launch.

Revenue.Creator Trading Fees To PFWA Buyback: 20% of a token vault's creator fees, which the harvest spends buying back and burning $PFWA.
Revenue.Creator Vault Fees To Protocol: The protocol's cut of each creator vault fee arrival (protocolBps, 10%), sent to the Credence Safe in the same transaction.
Revenue.Launch Fees To Protocol: Launch fees, withdrawn from the launchers by the Credence Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Creator Vault Fees To Protocol: The protocol's cut of each creator vault fee arrival (protocolBps, 10%).
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees To Protocol: Launch fees, withdrawn from the launchers by the Credence Safe.

HoldersRevenue.PFWA Buyback And Burn: 20% of a token vault's creator fees, which the next harvest swaps for $PFWA on the 1% WETH/PFWA Uniswap v3 pool and sends to the dead address.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Trading Fees To Prediction Bets: 80% of a token vault's creator fees, bridged to the token's PolyVault on Polygon to buy its Polymarket outcome; winnings buy back and burn the token.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Vault Fees To Creators: Creator vault fees after the protocol's cut, held for the X account until it claims them.

methodology.Fees: Everything traders and market creators pay on PFWA Markets: the trading fee on buys and on sells after a market's deadline, the early-sell penalty on sells before the deadline, and the fee to create a market. Activity of PFWA's own wallets (team, market seeder, market-making agent) is excluded.
methodology.UserFees: Everything traders and market creators pay on PFWA Markets: trading fees, early-sell penalties and market creation fees.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of all fees: the protocol's leg of every trading fee (both legs on markets the protocol created), half of every early-sell penalty, and the market creation fee, including the part spent buying back and burning $PFWA.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The fees sent to the PFWA treasury: the protocol's leg of every trading fee (both legs on markets the protocol created), half of every early-sell penalty, and the part of each market creation fee not used for the $PFWA buyback.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ETH spent buying $PFWA that is burned: half of each v2 market creation fee is swapped for $PFWA in the same transaction and sent to the dead address.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The market creator's leg of the trading fee on markets created by users, and the half of each early-sell penalty paid into the market's bonus pot for the winning side.

Fees.Trading Fees: The fee on buys and on sells after a market's deadline: feePercentage per mille of the trade, charged once for the market creator and once for the protocol (1% + 1% on current markets, 1.5% + 1.5% on older ones).
Fees.Early Sell Penalties: The penalty on sells before a market's deadline: sellFeePercentage per mille of the proceeds (10% on current markets).
Fees.Market Creation Fees: The flat fee paid to create a market (0.001 ETH on the v2 factory, 0.0005 ETH on v1). Markets the protocol's relayer creates pay none.

UserFees.Trading Fees: The fee on buys and on sells after a market's deadline, paid by the trader.
UserFees.Early Sell Penalties: The penalty on sells before a market's deadline, paid by the seller.
UserFees.Market Creation Fees: The flat fee paid by the market's creator.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's leg of the trading fee, plus the creator's leg on markets whose creator is the PFWA treasury.
Revenue.Early Sell Penalties To Protocol: Half of each early-sell penalty, sent to the PFWA treasury.
Revenue.Market Creation Fees To Protocol: The part of the market creation fee sent to the PFWA treasury (all of it on v1, half on v2).
Revenue.Market Creation Fees To PFWA Buyback: The part of each v2 market creation fee spent buying back and burning $PFWA (half, buybackBurnPercentage 5000 bps).

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's leg of the trading fee, plus the creator's leg on markets whose creator is the PFWA treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Early Sell Penalties To Protocol: Half of each early-sell penalty, sent to the PFWA treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Market Creation Fees To Protocol: The part of the market creation fee sent to the PFWA treasury.

HoldersRevenue.PFWA Buyback And Burn: WETH the v2 factory spends on $PFWA (1% WETH/PFWA Uniswap v3 pool) that it then transfers to the dead address, inside each paid market creation.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's leg of the trading fee, on markets created by users.
SupplySideRevenue.Early Sell Penalties To Winners: Half of each early-sell penalty, added to the market's bonus pot and paid to the winning side when the market resolves.

methodology.Fees: The 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool that is paid into the round's prize pot. Direct deposits into the pots are not fees and are excluded.
methodology.UserFees: The 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool, paid by the swapper into the round's prize pot.
methodology.Revenue: The share of the pot fees that buys back and burns $PFWA: 10% in Season 1 (ETH/$PFWA pool) and 7% in Season 2 (ETH/$IMD pool) of what is left after the Dice randomness fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Zero: the protocol keeps none of the pot fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of the pot fees spent buying back and burning $PFWA (10% in Season 1, 7% in Season 2, after Dice randomness fees), counted when the swap pays the fee. Burns funded by direct pot deposits are excluded.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The Dice Protocol fees paid from the pot for Flip moves, then the share of the remaining pot fees paid to players: the round's prizes (80% in Season 1, 78% in Season 2), the share rolled into the next round's pot (10% and 5%), and in Season 2 the 10% that buys back and burns $IMD, the game pool's token.

Fees.Pot Fees: 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool, paid into the round's prize pot.

UserFees.Pot Fees: 5% of the ETH side of every swap in a Sherwood game pool, paid by the swapper.

Revenue.Pot Fees To PFWA Buyback And Burn: The pot share that buys back and burns $PFWA: 10% in Season 1, 7% in Season 2, of the pot fees left after Dice fees.

HoldersRevenue.PFWA Buyback And Burn: The pot share that buys back and burns $PFWA: 10% in Season 1, 7% in Season 2, of the pot fees left after Dice fees, counted when the swap pays the fee.

SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees To Dice Randomness: The Dice Protocol randomness fee each Flip move pays out of the pot (Dice's getFeeV2, read at the end of the period).
SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees To Winners: The round's prizes: 50/20/10% to the top three in Season 1; 40/20/10% to the top three and 8% to the King of the Hill in Season 2. Referral cuts, forfeited and unclaimed prizes stay within the players' pots.
SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees Rolled Into Next Round: The share that rolls into the next round's pot (10% in Season 1, 5% in Season 2).
SupplySideRevenue.Pot Fees To IMD Buyback And Burn: Season 2 only: the 10% that buys back and burns $IMD, the game pool's token (not PFWA's).
