SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Algebra: Algebra's licence fee, 1% of permissionless pools' swap fees.

methodology.Fees: The 2% fee on every buy and sell of a coin launched on Sapling, the flat fee paid to plant a coin, and Sapling's fee on buys, plantings and sales made from a Zcash account. On Robinhood Chain: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee on every buy and sell of a coin planted through Sapling, both paid to Sapling's splitter, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee, paid in USDG to the treasury. On Raydium LaunchLab (from 2026-10-28): any platform fee claimed from the curve and Sapling's fees from the coin's graduated pool; excludes the coin's transfer tax (Sapling's 2.00% plus the deployer's tax of none to 3%), which is taken on every transfer of the coin, wallet to wallet included.
methodology.Revenue: The part of the 2% coin trading fee Sapling keeps (10% treasury, 25% $SAPLING buyback and burn, 25% $SAPLING/ZEC liquidity), plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, all of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees (a quarter each to the treasury, the flywheel, $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool). On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's share: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, the treasury's and the flywheel's quarters of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 50% of the 2% coin trading fee: 25% buys and burns $SAPLING, and 25% goes to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap, where about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee. For LaunchLab coins, half of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees: $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool, whose position is locked for good.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee, paid to each coin's deployer, a wallet they choose, or the holders of that coin as holder rewards (on Robinhood Chain, 40% of what reaches Sapling's splitter). LaunchLab coins pay their deployers from the coin's transfer tax, which is not counted.

Fees.Coin Trading Fees: The 2% fee on every buy and sell of a coin launched on Sapling, collected and split on chain by the Sapling vault program. On Robinhood Chain: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee, paid to Sapling's splitter and split there. For LaunchLab coins: any platform fee claimed from the curve and Sapling's fees from the graduated pool, both in ZEC (the coin's transfer tax is not counted).
Fees.Zcash Account Fees: Sapling's fee on a buy, planting or sale made from a Zcash account.
Fees.Coin Planting Fees: The flat fee paid to the Sapling treasury when a coin is planted, in the same transaction that creates the coin.

Revenue.Coin Trading Fees To Treasury: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, sent to the Sapling treasury. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
Revenue.Coin Planting Fees To Treasury: The flat planting fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
Revenue.Zcash Account Fees To Treasury: The Zcash account fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
Revenue.Sapling Coins Buyback And Burn: A quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees of LaunchLab coins, spent buying back and burning the top Sapling coins.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, used to buy $SAPLING and burn it (burned directly for coins paired with $SAPLING). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
Revenue.$SAPLING/ZEC Liquidity: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, added to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap: about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it (held in a vault per coin before 2026-10-02, then moved into the same liquidity). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees, added to a protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool whose position is locked for good.

ProtocolRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Treasury: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, sent to the Sapling treasury. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Coin Planting Fees To Treasury: The flat planting fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Zcash Account Fees To Treasury: The Zcash account fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Sapling Coins Buyback And Burn: A quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees of LaunchLab coins, spent buying back and burning the top Sapling coins.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, used to buy $SAPLING and burn it (burned directly for coins paired with $SAPLING). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
HoldersRevenue.$SAPLING/ZEC Liquidity: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, added to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap: about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it (held in a vault per coin before 2026-10-02, then moved into the same liquidity). SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Coin Holders: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee of coins whose deployer chose holder rewards, paid in ZEC to the holders of that coin. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter.
SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Deployers Or Coin H: On Robinhood Chain, the 40% share of fees Pons's escrow held before a sweep tied them to a coin, paid later to that coin's deployer or holders.

methodology.Fees: Everything paid into STANDARD: the ETH tax on every STANDARD/ETH swap and LP exit, charter auction prices in ETH, launchpad trade fees in the launch's pair asset plus the fixed launch fee, LP fees on the protocol's Uniswap v4 pools, license auction payments and charter exit fees paid in STANDARD, and S-Bills early-exit fees.
methodology.UserFees: Swap taxes, auction prices, launchpad trade fees, pool swap fees and exit fees are all paid by users.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator share of launchpad trade fees, the third-party LP share of fees on the protocol's pools, and informant bounties on charter revocations.
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus the supply side: the part of fees kept by the protocol and its token holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue received by the protocol: ETH swap and LP-exit taxes and charter auction proceeds at the fee splitter, launchpad protocol fees and launch fees at the fee multisig, and the treasury's LP fee income. STANDARD fees that are retired or burned go to holders and are excluded, and ETH spent on STANDARD buybacks is deducted in the period the buyback executes, so heavy buyback days can be negative.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ETH spent by PolBuyback and the ContractionVault buying STANDARD on the canonical pool, recognised when each buyback executes, plus STANDARD retired or burned out of fees: license auction payments, charter exit fees, the STANDARD side of the LP-exit tax and of the STANDARD/ETH pool fee, and S-Bills exit fees. S-Bills premiums distribute the bought-back STANDARD and are covered by the buyback line.

Fees.STANDARD/ETH LP Exit Tax: ETH and STANDARD tax charged by the TaxHook when non-protocol liquidity exits the STANDARD/ETH pool (LpTaxCollected).
Fees.Charter Auctions: ETH paid for charters in the daily charter auction (CharterPurchased).
Fees.Launchpad Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of launchpad trade fees, received by the fee multisig in the launch's pair asset.
Fees.Launchpad Fees To Creators: Creator share of launchpad trade fees credited in FeeEscrow.
Fees.Launch Fees: Fixed 0.0005 ETH fee per token launch, counted from Launched events.
Fees.Treasury LP Fees: Treasury Safe's share of swap fees on the protocol's v4 pools, from PoolManager Swap events.
Fees.Third-Party LP Fees: Third-party LPs' share of swap fees on the protocol's v4 pools.
Fees.License Auctions: STANDARD paid for branch licenses and retired from the ledger (LicensesPurchased).
Fees.Charter Exit Fees: STANDARD fee charged on charter withdrawals and revocations (Withdrawn, Revoked).
Fees.S-Bills Exit Fees: STANDARD fee charged on S-Bills early exits (Exited).

SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Fees To Creators: Creator share of launchpad trade fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Third-Party LP Fees: Third-party LPs' share of pool swap fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Revocation Bounties: Bounty paid to the informant on a charter revocation.

Revenue.Launchpad Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of launchpad trade fees.
Revenue.Treasury LP Fees: Treasury's share of pool swap fees.
Revenue.Charter Exit Fees: Charter exit fees net of informant bounties.

HoldersRevenue.License Auctions: STANDARD paid for licenses and retired from supply.
HoldersRevenue.Charter Exit Fees: Charter exit fees in STANDARD, half recycled to remaining charters and half retired.
HoldersRevenue.S-Bills Exit Fees: S-Bills exit fees in STANDARD, half burned and half paid to remaining bills.

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The fee a partner site charges in Scrooge's swap widget, paid to that site.

methodology.UserFees: Trading fees paid by traders on bonding curves and on graduated pools.
methodology.Revenue: The 1% protocol fee taken on every trade.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator fee of 0, 0.25 or 0.5% paid to the token creator on every trade.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of the 1% protocol fee, booked for operations.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The other half of the protocol fee, counted when it is released on chain to the executor that buys back and burns ALPHA. Amounts booked for the buyback but not yet released are not counted. Not tracked on Solana.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees paid on bonding curve trades.
Fees.Graduated Pool Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees charged by the ALPHA hook on graduated Uniswap v4 pools, and the ALPHA share of Meteora DAMM v2 pool fees on Solana.

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees paid on bonding curve trades.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Trading Fees: Protocol and creator fees charged by the ALPHA hook on graduated Uniswap v4 pools, and the ALPHA share of Meteora DAMM v2 pool fees on Solana.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Protocol: The 1% protocol fee on bonding curve trades.
Revenue.Graduated Pool Trading Fees To Protocol: The 1% protocol fee on graduated pool trades.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Creators: The creator fee on bonding curve trades.
SupplySideRevenue.Graduated Pool Trading Fees To Creators: The creator fee on graduated pool trades.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees To Operations: Half of the 1% protocol fee, booked for operations.

HoldersRevenue.Protocol Fees Released To ALPHA Buyback: Protocol fees released on chain to the executor that buys back and burns ALPHA.

methodology.Volume: Trading in Book tokens on TOKENIZE.FUN (a Book is a token backed by one trader's vault): buys and sells on each Book's launch curve, tax included. Swaps in the Uniswap v3 or v4 pool a Book moves to once it bonds are excluded. Only Books priced in WETH or STONKBROKER are counted.
methodology.Fees: Paid by Book traders and holders: the anti-snipe tax on launch-curve buys and sells (it decays after a Book launches), the swap fee in each Book's locked Uniswap pool, and a 2% fee on a Book's closing value when its epoch ends and the vault is liquidated.
methodology.Revenue: The StonkBrokers protocol's share of fees: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH, which have no StockBooster share) and half of the 2% close fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH) and half of the 2% close fee, paid to the StonkBrokers treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid out to others: 75% of the anti-snipe tax into the Book's vault for its holders, 8.33% to the Book's creator, 8.34% on WETH Books to StockBooster dividends for activated StonkBrokers, all swap fees from the locked pools to Book LP stakers and the vault, and half of the 2% close fee to Mancer, which hosts Books.

Fees.Book Anti Snipe Tax: Anti-snipe tax on launch-curve buys and sells, which decays after a Book launches. 75% goes to the Book's vault, 8.33% to the creator, 8.33% to the treasury and 8.34% to StockBooster (to the treasury on Books not priced in WETH).
Fees.Book Locked Pool LP Fees: Swap fee on trades in each Book's locked Uniswap v3 or v4 pool, measured on the WETH or STONKBROKER side.
Fees.Book Close Fee: 2% of the Book's closing value when its epoch ends and the vault is liquidated, split evenly between the StonkBrokers treasury and Mancer, which hosts Books.

Revenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Protocol: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH), kept by the protocol.
Revenue.Book Close Fee To Protocol: Half of the 2% close fee, kept by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Protocol: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax (16.67% on Books not priced in WETH), paid to the StonkBrokers treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Book Close Fee To Protocol: Half of the 2% close fee, paid to the StonkBrokers treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Book Vault: 75% of the anti-snipe tax, paid into the Book's vault for its holders.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To Creator: 8.33% of the anti-snipe tax, paid to the Book's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Anti Snipe Tax To StockBooster: 8.34% of the anti-snipe tax on WETH Books, paid to StockBooster dividends for activated StonkBrokers.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Locked Pool LP Fees: All swap fees from the locked Book pools, paid to Book LP stakers and the Book vault's own LP position.
SupplySideRevenue.Book Close Fee To Mancer: Half of the 2% close fee, paid to Mancer, which hosts Books.

methodology.Volume: Bonding curve price of every Clutch TV pass bought or sold, plus the gross amount of every tip (net to the streamer plus the protocol fee).
methodology.Fees: 2.5% protocol fee on pass trades and tips, plus the streamer royalty paid on every pass trade.
methodology.Revenue: The 2.5% protocol fee on pass trades and tips, collected by the ClutchFeeRouter.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 40% of the protocol fee, sent to the StonkBrokers treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 60% of the protocol fee, used to buy back and burn STONKBROKER.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Royalties paid to streamers on pass trades. Tips themselves go to streamers and are counted as volume, not fees.

Fees.Pass Trade Protocol Fee: 2.5% protocol fee charged on every pass buy and sell.
Fees.Pass Trade Streamer Royalty: Streamer royalty charged on every pass buy and sell (set per channel, max 10%).
Fees.Tip Protocol Fee: 2.5% protocol fee taken from every tip.

ProtocolRevenue.Pass Trade Protocol Fee: 40% of the pass trade protocol fee to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Tip Protocol Fee: 40% of the tip protocol fee to the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.STONKBROKER Buyback And Burn: 60% of all protocol fees, used to buy back and burn STONKBROKER.

methodology.UserFees: 3% of the premium paid by option buyers and 0.1% of the strike paid by option holders when they exercise, in WETH.
methodology.Fees: 3% of the premium when an option offer fills and 0.1% of the strike when an option is exercised, paid in WETH. Premiums received by option writers are not fees and are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: All option premium and exercise fees, collected by the Kyte FeeVault and split between KYTE stakers, KYTE buy-and-burn and the ops wallet.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 50% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the Kyte ops wallet.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 50% of option premium and exercise fees: 30% paid to KYTE stakers in WETH and 20% sent to the KYTE buy-and-burn contract.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue

Fees.Option Premium Fees: 3% of the premium on every filled option offer.
Fees.Option Exercise Fees: 0.1% of the strike on every option exercise.

UserFees.Option Premium Fees: 3% of the premium, paid by the option buyer.
UserFees.Option Exercise Fees: 0.1% of the strike, paid by the option holder on exercise.

Revenue.Fees To KYTE Stakers: 30% of option premium and exercise fees, paid to KYTE stakers in WETH.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: 20% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the KYTE buy-and-burn contract.
Revenue.Fees To Ops: 50% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the Kyte ops wallet.

HoldersRevenue.Fees To KYTE Stakers: 30% of option premium and exercise fees, paid to KYTE stakers in WETH.
HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 20% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the KYTE buy-and-burn contract.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Ops: 50% of option premium and exercise fees, sent to the Kyte ops wallet.

methodology.Volume: Volume of trades on LoopUP bonding curves, in the quote asset. Trades in graduated Uniswap V4 pools are not included, they are counted under Uniswap V4.
methodology.Fees: Launch fees, the 1% swap fee on bonding-curve trades and graduated Uniswap V4 pool trades (including the short decaying anti-snipe tax at launch), and any optional creator tax, all paid by traders and launchers.
methodology.UserFees: Launch fees, swap fees and creator tax paid by LoopUP traders and token launchers.
methodology.Revenue: Launch fees kept by the LoopUP treasury, plus the 20% of every swap fee used to buy back and burn $LOOP, plus the creator share and creator tax of the $LOOP token itself, which also go to the burn.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 60% of every swap fee and all creator tax paid to token creators, and the 20% of every swap fee paid to Loopers, the verified callers who earn on the trades of tokens they call. The $LOOP token's own creator share is burned instead and is not included.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Flat ETH launch fees paid to the LoopUP treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The 20% of every swap fee used to buy back and burn $LOOP, plus the creator share and creator tax of the $LOOP token itself, whose creator fee recipient is the burn wallet.

Fees.Launch Fees: Flat ETH fee paid for every token launched (LoopV2LaunchFactory.launchFee).
Fees.Curve Swap Fees: 1% fee (plus the decaying anti-snipe tax at launch) on every bonding-curve buy and sell, from CurveBuy and CurveSell events.
Fees.Graduated Pool Swap Fees: 1% fee skimmed by the LoopUP Uniswap V4 hook on every graduated-pool swap, from HookFeeCollected events; fees taken in the memecoin are valued at the price of the swap they came from.
Fees.Creator Tax: Optional creator-chosen trade tax on curve and graduated-pool trades.

UserFees.Launch Fees: Flat ETH fee paid by the launcher of every token.
UserFees.Curve Swap Fees: 1% fee paid by traders on every bonding-curve trade.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Swap Fees: 1% fee paid by traders on every graduated Uniswap V4 pool swap.
UserFees.Creator Tax: Optional creator tax paid by traders.

Revenue.Launch Fees To Treasury: Launch fees sent to the LoopUP treasury leg of the LoopFeeSplitter.
Revenue.Swap Fees To LOOP Buyback And Burn: 20% of the swap fee (half of the 40% protocol share) used to buy back and burn $LOOP, plus the creator share of tokens whose creator fee recipient is the burn wallet ($LOOP itself).
Revenue.Creator Tax To LOOP Buyback And Burn: Creator tax of tokens whose creator fee recipient is the $LOOP burn wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Creators: 60% of the swap fee, paid to each token's creator fee recipient.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Looper Rewards: 20% of the swap fee (half of the 40% protocol share), paid to the KolRewardsDistributor for Looper (caller) rewards.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Memecoin Buyback And Lock: Part of the creator share used to buy back and lock the traded memecoin when a creator enables it (0% on all current launches).
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Token Creators: Creator tax, paid in full to the token's creator fee recipient.

ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees To Treasury: Launch fees sent to the LoopUP treasury leg of the LoopFeeSplitter.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To LOOP Buyback And Burn: 20% of the swap fee used to buy back and burn $LOOP, plus the creator share of $LOOP itself, whose creator fee recipient is the burn wallet.
HoldersRevenue.Creator Tax To LOOP Buyback And Burn: Creator tax of tokens whose creator fee recipient is the $LOOP burn wallet.

methodology.UserFees: Opening and time fees paid by borrowers on HedgeHood StockLend loans of tokenized stocks.
methodology.Fees: Fees borrowers pay to borrow tokenized stocks on HedgeHood StockLend: an opening fee when a loan is taken and a time fee when it is repaid. Excludes flash-loan fees (paid in the stock token), bonuses paid to liquidators, and the time fee settled inside a liquidation or buy-in, which the contract does not record.
methodology.Revenue: HedgeHood's share of the opening and time fees borrowers pay, set per market (10% on every market as of November 2026).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: HedgeHood's share of the opening and time fees borrowers pay (10% on every market as of November 2026), collected by the HedgeHood treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the opening and time fees borrowers pay (90% on every market as of November 2026), streamed to the lenders who supplied the stock.

Fees.Loan Opening Fees: Charged when a loan opens; it grows with how far the stock token trades above its oracle price on the DEX pool, and is zero when there is no such premium.
Fees.Loan Time Fees: Charged at repayment: an annual rate on the borrowed amount for the time the loan was open (5% a year while the stock market is open and 20% while it is closed, as of November 2026).

UserFees.Loan Opening Fees: Opening fees borrowers pay when a loan opens.
UserFees.Loan Time Fees: Time fees borrowers pay at repayment for the time the loan was open.

Revenue.Loan Opening Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan opening fees.
Revenue.Loan Time Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan time fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Loan Opening Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan opening fees, collected by the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Loan Time Fees To Protocol: HedgeHood's share of loan time fees, collected by the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Loan Opening Fees To Lenders: Lenders' share of loan opening fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Loan Time Fees To Lenders: Lenders' share of loan time fees.

methodology.UserFees: The trading fee traders pay on each fill's premium (0.05% of the premium, paid by the taker), plus the price improvement kept when two crossing orders are matched.
methodology.Fees: The trading fee on each fill's premium (0.05% of the premium, paid by the taker), plus the price improvement kept when two crossing orders are matched. It is credited to the protocol's fee recipient inside the market at the fill (PremiumSettled.fee). The market makers' spread and the options' settlement payouts are not fees.
methodology.Revenue: All trading fees on option premiums go to the protocol (the FeeSweeper forwards them to the HedgeHood options Safe).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All trading fees on option premiums go to the protocol (the FeeSweeper forwards them to the HedgeHood options Safe).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue
methodology.NotionalVolume: The shares of the underlying stock in each fill (Traded.quantity), valued at the stock token price. Every fill is counted once, whether a taker filled a signed order or two orders were matched.
methodology.PremiumVolume: What the buyer pays in USDG for each fill (PremiumSettled.sellerGets + fee).

Fees.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill on the seven markets, in USDG.

UserFees.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill on the seven markets, in USDG.

Revenue.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill, credited to the protocol fee recipient.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading fees on option premiums: PremiumSettled.fee of every fill, credited to the protocol fee recipient.

methodology.UserFees: Pays management + performance fees
methodology.Fees: wstO taken from every swap in wstO/launch-token pairs and burned, valued as the O it redeems for in that chain's vault.
methodology.Revenue: No swap burn fees are retained as protocol revenue; all accrue to vault stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: No swap fees go to the o1.exchange treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All wstO swap burn fees accrue to vault stakers through a higher O redemption value per remaining wstO share.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No swap burn fees are classified as governance-token holder revenue; vault staker income is supply-side revenue.

Fees.wstO Swap Burn Fees: wstO burned by the wstO launch hook on buys and sells (1% buy/sell defaults, frozen per pool at creation from the factory defaults), valued in O at the period's closing share rate of that chain's vault.

SupplySideRevenue.wstO Swap Burn Fees To Stakers: The O backing burned wstO stays in the vault and benefits all remaining vault stakers through the share redemption rate.

methodology.Fees: Stoa's protocol fee (2 bps of the output) paid on every swap routed through Stoa on Robinhood Chain and Elysium.
methodology.Revenue: Stoa's protocol fee on every swap, minus the 10% share credited to the swap's referrer when it has one.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of the swap fee kept by the Stoa treasury: on Elysium, and on Robinhood Chain before the fees were handed to the $STOA buyback.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: On Robinhood Chain since the buyback handover, the protocol's share of the swap fee, which can only be swapped into $STOA and burned.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 10% share of the swap fee credited to the referrer of each referred swap.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: 2 bps protocol fee charged by the router on the final leg, or by each Stoa maker pool a swap goes through.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: Protocol share of the swap fee kept by the Stoa treasury.
Revenue.Swap Fees To $STOA Buyback: Protocol share of the swap fee reserved for StoaBuyback, which buys $STOA and burns it.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: Protocol share of the swap fee kept by the Stoa treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Protocol share of the swap fee used to buy $STOA and burn it.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Referrers: 10% of the swap fee credited to the referrer of the swap.

methodology.Fees: Fees charged by Hookr on Robinhood Chain: Hook Block swap charges, token taxes, recaptured arbitrage, revenue token fees, launch fees, liquidity vault fees and fees of the earlier Hookr launchpads. Excludes Uniswap LP fees, including the extra LP fees some Hook Blocks set (tracked under Uniswap v4), and the share of arbitrage that What The Hook keeps.
methodology.Revenue: Hookr's share of the fees, after pool creators, integrators, advisory contracts, traders, LPs and partners are paid.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The part of the fees paid to pool creators, integrators, advisory contracts, traders, LPs and partners, or burned in a pool's own token.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Hookr's share of the fees minus the part allocated to HOOKR burns. Can be negative on a day the burn jar claims fees earned earlier.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Hookr's fee income allocated to burning HOOKR, counted when it is allocated: half of the treasury's income since 2026-10-31 (claimed by the burn jar), the earlier flywheel charge, and fees taken in HOOKR and burned. Excludes HOOKR buy-and-burns paid for by other projects.

Fees.Hook Swap Charges: Fees that Hook Blocks charge on swaps in Hookr pools, shared between Hookr, the pool creator, integrator apps and advisory contracts. Token taxes are counted when they settle, under Tax And Conversion.
Fees.Tax And Conversion Settlements: Buy and sell taxes collected by the Tax + Conversion Hook Block, counted once when they are settled.
Fees.Recaptured Arbitrage: Arbitrage profit captured in Hookr pools by the What The Hook integration and shared with traders, LPs, pool creators and Hookr. The share What The Hook keeps is excluded; it is counted in its own listing.
Fees.Subject Token Burn Charges: Fees taken in a pool's own launched token and burned, which benefits that token's holders.
Fees.HOOKR Token Burn Charges: Fees taken in HOOKR in HOOKR pools and burned.
Fees.Launch And Root Deployment Fees: Fees paid to launch a pool or deploy an owned root.
Fees.Liquidity Vault Performance Fees: Performance fee taken from the LP fees earned by the liquidity vault.
Fees.Revenue Tokenizer Fees: Hookr's fee on income paid to revenue tokens. On the original tokenizer 20% of it is owed to What The Hook, the execution partner.
Fees.Modular Hook Charges: Swap fees charged by pools of the earlier modular Hookr release.
Fees.Legacy Launch And Trading Fees: Launch fees, bonding-curve trading fees and pool fees of the generation 3 to 5 Hookr launchpads, shared between Hookr and token creators.
Fees.Legacy Flywheel Charges: Generation 5 swap charge sent to the HOOKR buy-and-burn contract.

Revenue.Hook Swap Charges To Hookr: Fees that Hook Blocks charge on swaps in Hookr pools, shared between Hookr, the pool creator, integrator apps and advisory contracts. Token taxes are counted when they settle, under Tax And Conversion.
Revenue.Tax And Conversion To Hookr: Buy and sell taxes collected by the Tax + Conversion Hook Block, counted once when they are settled.
Revenue.Recaptured Arbitrage To Hookr: Arbitrage profit captured in Hookr pools by the What The Hook integration and shared with traders, LPs, pool creators and Hookr. The share What The Hook keeps is excluded; it is counted in its own listing.
Revenue.HOOKR Token Fees Burned For Holders: Fees taken in HOOKR in HOOKR pools and burned.
Revenue.Launch And Deployment Fees To Hookr: Fees paid to launch a pool or deploy an owned root.
Revenue.Liquidity Vault Performance Fees To Hook: Performance fee taken from the LP fees earned by the liquidity vault.
Revenue.Revenue Tokenizer Fees To Hookr: Hookr's fee on income paid to revenue tokens. On the original tokenizer 20% of it is owed to What The Hook, the execution partner.
Revenue.Modular Hook Charges To Hookr: Swap fees charged by pools of the earlier modular Hookr release.
Revenue.Legacy Launch And Trading Fees To Hookr: Launch fees, bonding-curve trading fees and pool fees of the generation 3 to 5 Hookr launchpads, shared between Hookr and token creators.
Revenue.Legacy Flywheel Charges For HOOKR Burns: Generation 5 swap charge sent to the HOOKR buy-and-burn contract.

SupplySideRevenue.Hook Swap Charges To Creators, Integrato: Fees that Hook Blocks charge on swaps in Hookr pools, shared between Hookr, the pool creator, integrator apps and advisory contracts. Token taxes are counted when they settle, under Tax And Conversion.
SupplySideRevenue.Tax And Conversion To Creators: Buy and sell taxes collected by the Tax + Conversion Hook Block, counted once when they are settled.
SupplySideRevenue.Recaptured Arbitrage To Traders, LPs And: Arbitrage profit captured in Hookr pools by the What The Hook integration and shared with traders, LPs, pool creators and Hookr. The share What The Hook keeps is excluded; it is counted in its own listing.
SupplySideRevenue.Subject Token Burns For Pool Participant: Fees taken in a pool's own launched token and burned, which benefits that token's holders.
SupplySideRevenue.Revenue Tokenizer Fees To Execution Part: Hookr's fee on income paid to revenue tokens. On the original tokenizer 20% of it is owed to What The Hook, the execution partner.
SupplySideRevenue.Modular Hook Charges To Creators And Poo: Swap fees charged by pools of the earlier modular Hookr release.
SupplySideRevenue.Legacy Trading Fees To Creators: Launch fees, bonding-curve trading fees and pool fees of the generation 3 to 5 Hookr launchpads, shared between Hookr and token creators.

ProtocolRevenue.Hookr Retained Fee Income: Hookr's share of the fees, minus the part allocated to HOOKR burns.

HoldersRevenue.Fees Allocated To HOOKR Burn Jar: Half of the treasury's fee income, claimed by the burn jar, which hands it to whoever burns the required HOOKR.
HoldersRevenue.Legacy Flywheel Charges For HOOKR Burns: Generation 5 swap charge credited to the HOOKR buy-and-burn contract.
HoldersRevenue.HOOKR Token Fees Burned For Holders: Fees taken in HOOKR in HOOKR pools and burned.

methodology.Fees: Rushr's platform fee on trades made through the Rushr app or agent API (0.25% during the beta), counted as the ETH and USDG received by the Rushr treasury Safe.
methodology.Revenue: All platform fees are kept by the protocol treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All platform fees are kept by the protocol treasury.

Fees.Trading Fees: Platform fee paid on each trade made through Rushr, received by the treasury Safe in ETH (SafeReceived logs) or USDG (token transfers).

Revenue.Trading Fees: The full platform fee, kept by the protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: The full platform fee, kept by the protocol treasury.
